turns.text: Hey, how's your day been so far?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I want to buy my grandkids some clothes, but I don't know their sizes anymore.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Kids grow so fast. How old are they?

turns.text: One is four and the other just turned seven.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Kids' sizes roughly follow age, so a size five and a size eight would give them room to grow.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Oh, so buy a little bigger.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Exactly. Slightly big is fine, too small is useless. And keep the receipt just in case.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Maybe I should ask my daughter

turns.speaker: user

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Then go one size up and pick something soft and comfy, like pajamas or a hoodie. Those are hard to get wrong.
